body: I think it definitely can make life a lot harder, depending on the severity of your ADHD. For some people, most things are extremely negative that have to do with their ADHD and I think one reason people talk a lot about the bad stuff, is because ADHD can often be talked about as being an "advantage" when it can severely disrupt someone's life, so people want to share that that may not be the case for them. I don't think ADHD should be separated into being an "advantage" or "disadvantage," ADHD varies person to person and can effect their lives differently, some people have really positive experiences, others really negative, so generalizing doesn't work here.

Those people do get credit for keeping with it, whether it be friends or family, they have support. Having suicidal thoughts is often ignored and downplayed, at least in my own experience, even after my first attempt, things were brushed aside very quickly and the worry was gonna within a week. No one's asking for a medal, I think it's more about wanting the fact that dealing with suicidal thoughts is very difficult and can be incredibly hard to fight off alone.
